description: Goal: reconcile draft P1-P8 with the two independent reviewer result sets into dispositioned findings. Method per review-response.md: (1) Tabulate every [agy] and [muse] finding separately (never merged) alongside original P1-P8 as reviewer|severity|location|disposition|evidence|remediation. (2) Assign exactly one disposition per finding — ACCEPT, NARROW, ALREADY_FIXED, DEFER(-blocked or -unverified), or REBUT — with the evidence each requires; re-verify against current tree (not brief static snapshot); preserve disagreement between reviewers rather than picking a side. (3) Append reconciliation as new section of _project/audits/result-bundle-downstream-compat-2026-09-18.md created by this item (frontmatter date: 2026-09-18, develop_sha: ed4907010), following existing _project/audits/ convention. Inputs: Phase-1 reviewer outputs + responder status, draft P1-P8 text (see dispatch TODO), current tree. Does not apply fixes — triage only; ACCEPT/NARROW small file-scoped items go to integrate-fixes TODO, design-decision items go to follow-on TODOs.
